# RAFIQ AUTO & OIL TRADERS (رفیق آٹو اینڈ آئل ٹریڈرز)
> Wholesale Engine Oil Depot, Certified Automotive Lubricants & Dedicated Van Delivery Fleet across Okara, Kasur, and Sahiwal (Punjab, Pakistan).

## Core Products & Genuine Dealership Distribution
Rafiq Auto & Oil Traders is an authorized wholesale distributor and stockist for 100% genuine, certified automotive lubricants:
1. **Engine Oils (Passenger Car & Commercial Heavy Duty)**:
   - Viscosities: 0W-20, 5W-30, 5W-40 Fully Synthetic, 10W-40 Semi-Synthetic, 20W-50 Mineral, 15W-40 CI-4/CK-4 Heavy Duty Diesel Engine Oil.
   - Authorized Brand Stock: Shell Helix / Rimula, Total Quartz / Rubia, Mobil 1 / Delvac, ZIC X7 / X9 / M7, Castrol Magnatec / GTX, Caltex Havoline / Delo, Kixx G1 / HD1, PSO Carient / Deo.
2. **Oil Filters, Air Filters & Fuel Filters**:
   - Guard Filters (Authorized Dealership / Stockist), Leppon Filters, Genuine OEM filters for Toyota, Honda, Suzuki, Hyundai, and Kia.
3. **Motorcycle Oils (4T & 2T)**:
   - 20W-40, 20W-50, 10W-30 4T oils for Honda CG125, CD70, Yamaha YBR, Suzuki GS150, and 3-wheeler auto rickshaws.
4. **Gear Oils, Transmission Fluids & Greases**:
   - ATF Dexron III / IV, CVT Fluid, 80W-90, 85W-140 GL-5 Gear Lubricants, High-Temperature Wheel Bearing Greases.
5. **Car Care & Radiator Coolants**:
   - Ready-to-use Coolants (Green & Red), Concentrated Coolants, Brake Fluids (DOT 3, DOT 4), Car Shampoos, Windshield Cleaners.

## Wholesale Delivery Van Service (Okara, Kasur & Sahiwal)
- Rafiq Auto operates dedicated daily delivery vans (e.g. Shehzore delivery vehicles) supplying cartons and drums directly to:
  - Auto repair workshops, dealership service centers, lube change facilities, petrol pump service bays, transport fleet yards, and tractor / agricultural implement dealers.
  - Same-day dispatch and next-day route delivery across Okara, Kasur, and Sahiwal.

## Pricing & Khata (Credit Ledger) Policy
- **Retail Rates**: Displayed transparently on the public catalog.
- **Wholesale Carton Rates**: Negotiated bulk rates with party-wise rate lock history.
- **Credit (Udhar) Ledger**: Double-entry accounting system with computerized invoices, running balances, PDF ledger exports, and instant WhatsApp statements.
